title: QuaRot function-preserving coordinate sweep for int4 output weights
hypothesis: Selecting among exact block-Hadamard coordinate views lowers held-out int4 weight reconstruction error versus one randomized QuaRot view at bounded actual payload and transform compute.
physical_object: Pinned Pythia-70M output projection W, shape [50304,512]
mirror_coordinate: Per-32-channel orthogonal Hadamard with sign and permutation code
logical_multiplicity: Equivalent coordinate representations of one linear function; no functional multiplicity claim

rows.candidate_selection: minimum calibration-row relative Frobenius error among 16 randomized block-Hadamard views

development.selection_metric: held-out relative Frobenius error after int4; actual serialized inference bytes; operation proxy

paid_objects: sign and permutation arrays for Q
seed, method ID and schema metadata
storage.full_precision_common_base: rest of checkpoint is common; the replaced output-projection tensor is excluded from common bytes

success_gate: Both development worlds: at least 5% lower held-out NRMSE than single QuaRot; sweep payload within 1% of identical native sweep; added per-token transform FLOPs <=5% of quantized matrix-vector projection FLOPs.
failure_gate: Any quality/byte/compute miss, or exact native QuaRot sweep alias.
boundaries: Held-out rows are output-weight reconstruction audit, not natural text
No capacity or functional multiplicity claim
Fresh codes remain sealed after any development miss
